text:
anya (product): quick design review thread. noticed the in-console help surface uses three labels in different places: 'Help', 'Docs Hub', and 'Support'. this is confusing in usability tests. attaching mock: https://img.redwood.dev/console/docs-hub-proposal.png. can we align the label + behavior?

riley (design): i saw that too. my vote is 'Docs' (short, maps to external hub). also the search placeholder is inconsistent: some pages say 'Search docs' and others say 'Search help'. we should standardize copy.

sam (devex): totally agree on standardizing events. analytics is already tracking help.open and docs.open separately; funnels are fragmented. propose we emit a single event docs.panel.open and keep help.* as deprecated aliases for 30 days.

leo (frontend): from an implementation POV: panel variants exist as a drawer, a modal, and an inline sidecar depending on route. that's why keyboard focus behavior differs. we can unify to a single dialog component that supports two presentation modes but shares accessibility and analytics hooks.

jamie (a11y): accessibility notes from the audit: 1) use role=dialog + aria-modal=true for the panel. 2) ensure aria-labelledby points to the panel title. 3) if the panel is drawer-like, provide a skip link and trap focus while open. 4) for new tab links, include aria-label suffix '(opens in new tab)' rather than visible text. also add a visually-hidden element listing shortcuts (e.g., 'Press ? for command palette') so screen readers discover them.

riley (design): small UX tweak: move quick nav order to Docs, Runbooks, Examples, Integrations. also add a subtle breadcrumb at the top: 'Docs 79 Console' (small) so users know they're still in-app.

anya (product): question: do we keep inline contextual tooltips in the console (little '?' icons) in addition to the Docs panel? they compete if both surface the same content.

leo (frontend): i'd prefer inline tips for tiny clarifications and reserve the Docs panel for full reference + examples. we should ensure links from inline tips open the panel to the right anchor, not a new tab, unless explicitly external.

sam (devex): technical ask: can we add query param deep links like /console?docs=/api/embeddings&anchor=limits so support and SRE can share linkable states? that will help recordings and repro steps.

leo (frontend): router can accept docs param. i'll implement anchor handling and a small history.replaceState so closing the panel returns to the original URL (helps copy/paste).

jamie (a11y): one more: keyboard close MUST return focus to the original trigger element. if the trigger is hidden on small screens, return to a logical fallback (first focusable in main content).

riley (design): copy suggestion for the panel header: 'Docs 12 Console reference' and placeholder: 'Search docs, examples, and runbooks'. short and consistent.

anya (product): proposed action list: 1) adopt global label 'Docs' (owner: product - anya) 2) standardize search placeholder to 'Search docs, examples, and runbooks' (owner: design - riley) 3) unify analytics event to docs.panel.open and add 30d deprecated alias for help.open (owner: devex - sam) 4) implement dialog component with focus return + anchor deep-links (owner: frontend - leo) 5) a11y fixes: role/aria/skip + screenreader new-tab semantics (owner: a11y - jamie) 6) update inline tips behavior to open panel anchors instead of external tabs (owner: design/frontend)

leo (frontend): i'll open a PR for the dialog component and router handling. target: next sprint.

sam (devex): i'll coordinate the analytics rename and post deprecation notice to infra-runbook.

riley (design): i'll update the mocks and produce the small copy spec today, will ping docs & content. :spiral_note_pad:

deploy-bot: pushed staging build with docs panel changes https://staging.redwood.dev/console?docs=/api/embeddings&anchor=limits (build 2026-12-15T09:03Z) :rocket:

anya (product): thanks all. let's review staging on Thursday; i'll collect any outstanding UX edge-cases then. :thumbsup:
